summary: Iteration 94 - Pricing & Billing Testing Complete. All 12 backend tests passed. Fixed Quote and Invoice models to include order_id, source, and customer_name fields. Frontend /quotes and /invoices pages load correctly and display data.

integration_issues.issue: Page makes repeated API calls to /api/quotes and /api/customers (possible useEffect dependency issue causing re-renders)

critical_code_review_comments: Fixed Quote model in /app/backend/models/jobs.py to include order_id, source, and customer_name fields
Fixed Invoice model in /app/backend/models/jobs.py to include order_id, source, and customer_name fields
Pricing calculator correctly applies thickness_multiplier for rigid signs (1.0 for 4mm, 1.45 for 10mm)
Rush order multiplier (1.15x) correctly applied across all pricing categories
Order-generated quotes and invoices correctly stored with order_id and source='order' fields
GET /api/orders/{order_id}/financials correctly returns linked quotes, invoices, and work orders
seed_data_creation: Test orders and tickets created and cleaned up during tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 94 verified pricing and billing features: (1) POST /api/pricing/calculate correctly applies thickness_multiplier for rigid signs - 4mm=1.0x, 10mm=1.45x (verified with 48x36 sign: $133.21 vs $153.75), (2) Rush order flag increases price by 15% across all categories, (3) POST /api/orders/{id}/generate-quote creates quote with order_id and source='order' fields, (4) POST /api/orders/{id}/generate-invoice creates invoice with order_id and source='order' fields, (5) GET /api/orders/{id}/financials returns linked quotes/invoices/work_orders, (6) Frontend /quotes page loads and displays 19 quotes in table format, (7) Frontend /invoices page loads and displays 16 invoices with View/Pay Link/Mark Paid actions. Fixed Quote and Invoice Pydantic models to include order_id, source, customer_name fields that were being dropped due to extra='ignore' config.
